verdict.summary_en: Order confirmation OA26808441 from Karton Nowak to Soony Interactive GmbH for PO 4500318792 (dated 2026-11-13). One line: item 00010, CMP-GAM-004 Cover Sleeve Grand Heist 6 (USK/PEGI), 215,000 at 0.06 EUR, confirmed for 2026-12-04. Terms are DAP Hamburg and NET30. The supplier notes it printed to artwork rev. C, received from Soony Marketing on 2026-08-07.
red_flags: The supplier states the sleeve is printed to artwork rev. C (file GH6_sleeve_revC_USK2026.pdf, received 2026-08-07). The buyer should check that rev. C is the current approved revision for this USK/PEGI sleeve, because the document does not say whether a later revision exists.
observations: Machine-printed single-page PDF with no handwriting, stamps or signatures.
The document has no issue date; 2026-11-13 is the date of the buyer's order, not of the confirmation.
The quantity has no unit stated, and the price has no per-unit basis stated beyond the currency column.
